leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the env() function to access safe area inset values in CSS
Configure padding properties to accommodate device-specific safe areas
Implement safe area insets for both top and bottom viewport edges
Construct responsive layouts that adapt to different device notches and home indicators
Manipulate CSS custom properties to dynamically adjust safe area spacing
Integrate safe area insets with existing layout components
Control element positioning relative to device-specific viewport boundaries
